m1.memo:
Ops notes for Friday's vendor decision (support chat tool, 12 agents).

- Demo day: Brightpane's agent interface scored best of the three.
- Brightpane's list price is $15 per agent per month, the lowest.
- Brightpane connects to our shop platform in one click.
- Brightpane includes free onboarding and data migration.
- Kelvane's list price is $26 per agent per month, the highest.
- Cobbleline has no chat widget for mobile apps.
- I ran a two-week pilot with Kelvane and Brightpane side by side. Agents resolved tickets 30% faster on Kelvane than on our current tool.
- Kelvane's order lookup worked with our shop data without custom code.
- Brightpane went down for four hours, twice, during the pilot.

m2.memo: Finance notes for Friday's call on the three support-chat vendors, based on list prices and the written quotes I requested. Brightpane's agent interface won the demo, and its list price is the lowest at $15 per agent per month. It hooks into our shop platform in one click, and onboarding plus data migration are free. Kelvane is the most expensive on paper at $26 per agent per month. Cobbleline has no mobile chat widget. Kelvane will lock the per-seat price for three years and charges no overage fees when chat volume spikes. Brightpane's renewal price rises 35% after year one.

m3.memo:
Security review summary for Friday's vendor call.

- Brightpane: best-rated agent interface in the demo, and the lowest list price at $15 per agent per month.
- Brightpane hooks into our shop platform in one click; onboarding and data migration are free.
- Kelvane is the priciest at $26 per agent per month.
- Cobbleline: no chat widget for mobile apps.
- I read the audit reports and data-hosting terms for all three vendors this week. Kelvane's latest SOC 2 Type II report is clean.
- Kelvane keeps EU customer data in the EU at no extra charge.
- Brightpane stores all data in the US and offers no EU option.
